question: What is the first step when managing an AEM environment configuration?
answers: Create a backup of the current configuration
correct: Create a backup of the current configuration
reason: Antes de tocar una configuracion de entorno hay que respaldar la configuracion actual, de forma que se pueda revertir si el cambio provoca una regresion.

question: What is the primary purpose of the Sling Model Exporter in AEM?
answers: To convert AEM components into JSON for use in SPA frameworks
To cache AEM pages in the dispatcher
To enable dynamic replication of content
To manage OSGi configurations for templates
correct: To convert AEM components into JSON for use in SPA frameworks
reason: El Sling Model Exporter serializa un Sling Model a JSON mediante Jackson; ese JSON es lo que consumen las SPA y las integraciones headless.

question: Which approach is recommended for creating custom components in AEM?
answers: Use plain HTML and embed JavaScript directly
Develop components using HTL with Sling Models
Write JSP scripts for dynamic content rendering
Rely on XML to define component behavior
correct: Develop components using HTL with Sling Models
reason: La forma recomendada de crear componentes es HTL para la vista y Sling Models para la logica de negocio. JSP esta desaconsejado y embeber JavaScript en HTML plano rompe las buenas practicas.

question: Which steps should be taken to integrate a third-party API in AEM? (Choose two)
answers: Create OSGi services for API management
Modify dispatcher rules to enable API access
Implement servlets for handling API requests and responses
Use JCR queries to fetch API configurations
Add API endpoints directly to HTL templates
correct: Create OSGi services for API management
Implement servlets for handling API requests and responses
reason: Se crean servicios OSGi que encapsulan la conexion con la API externa y servlets Sling que atienden las peticiones del front-end y devuelven la respuesta.

question: An AEM developer is building custom templates by referring to sample template types in /libs/settings/wcm in AEM as a Cloud Service. The template works for a few days, and then it suddenly stops working and starts throwing exceptions. What could have caused this issue?
answers: The ACLs or group permissions were altered.
The developer was removed from the template authors group.
The template was accidentally deleted by the developer.
The instance of AEM was upgraded.
correct: The instance of AEM was upgraded.
reason: Los contenidos bajo /libs se sobrescriben en cada actualizacion de AEM as a Cloud Service. Si una plantilla propia referencia o hereda de /libs/settings/wcm, dejara de funcionar en cuanto la instancia se actualice; hay que copiar lo necesario a /apps o /conf.

question: You are tasked with optimizing query performance for a client’s AEM repository. Which steps should you take?
answers: Create an Oak index for frequently queried properties under /oak:index
Write custom JCR queries to bypass indexing
Optimize dispatcher rules to reduce query frequency
Use the Workflow Console to monitor query performance
correct: Create an Oak index for frequently queried properties under /oak:index
reason: Para optimizar el rendimiento de consultas se crea un indice Oak bajo /oak:index para las propiedades que se consultan con frecuencia, evitando asi el traversal del repositorio.

question: A developer is working with the servlet that is supported by Last-Modified header. Which servlet is being used?
correct: Adaptive Image Servlet
reason: El Adaptive Image Servlet soporta la cabecera Last-Modified, lo que permite responder 304 Not Modified y aprovechar la cache del navegador y del dispatcher.

question: Which maintenance tools can be used to optimize an AEM repository? (Choose two)
correct: Oak Maintenance Tool
AEM Operations Dashboard
reason: Las herramientas de mantenimiento para optimizar el repositorio son Oak Maintenance (revision cleanup, compaction, data store GC) y el Operations Dashboard, desde donde se programan y vigilan esas tareas.

question: An AEM developer is debugging a server-side Java file. The following code snippet is causing compilation errors: public class MyServlet extends SlingAllMethodsServlet { @Reference private ResourceResolver resourceResolver; protected void doGet(SlingHttpServletRequest request, SlingHttpServletResponse response) { PrintWriter out = response.getWriter(); out.println("Hello, world!"); } } What could be a possible cause of the compilation errors in this code?
answers: Void return type for doGet method
correct: Missing import statements
reason: El snippet no compila porque faltan las sentencias import (PrintWriter, IOException, las clases de Sling). Heredar de SlingAllMethodsServlet y declarar doGet como void es correcto.

question: Which dispatcher rule is most appropriate to block requests to .git directories in AEM?
correct: /rule { /glob "*.git/*" /type "deny" }
reason: La regla /rule { /glob "*.git/*" /type "deny" } en el filtro del dispatcher bloquea cualquier peticion dirigida a directorios .git.

question: A developer needs to obtain the JSON rendition of the index configuration. Which URL should be used to achieve this goal?
correct: https://serveraddress:port/oak:index.tidy.-1.json
reason: La rendicion JSON de la configuracion de indices se obtiene pidiendo el nodo /oak:index con el selector tidy y profundidad infinita: /oak:index.tidy.-1.json.

question: What are best practices for writing unit tests in AEM? (Choose two)
answers: Use JUnit with AEM Mocks for testing Sling Models
Perform testing directly on the production environment
Execute API calls from test cases in staging environments
correct: Use JUnit with AEM Mocks for testing Sling Models
Mock JCR repositories and resources
reason: Las buenas practicas son usar JUnit con AEM Mocks para probar los Sling Models y mockear el repositorio JCR y los recursos. Nunca se prueba contra produccion ni se lanzan llamadas reales a APIs desde los tests.

question: A developer is creating a new tenant called noot in an AEM Cloud Service instance. The team is using independent repositories for the different tenants. The team is also using git submodules tool. What must the developer do to ensure the new noot tenant repository is deployed?
answers: Push the changes of the noot repository to the Adobe git repository.
Add a reference to noot as a submodule of the main project in the team's git management tool.
Add a reference to the main project in the noot module in the Adobe git repository.
correct: Add a reference to noot as a submodule of the main project in the team's git management tool.
reason: Trabajando con submodulos de git, el nuevo repositorio del tenant debe anadirse como submodulo del proyecto principal para que el build de Cloud Manager lo incluya en el despliegue.

question: What is the role of the "Retry Delay" setting in an AEM replication agent's configuration?
answers: It defines how often replication failures will be retried.
It controls the delay between each replication trigger.
It specifies how long to wait before marking a replication job as failed.
It manages the interval at which the replication queue is processed.
correct: It defines how often replication failures will be retried.
reason: 'Retry Delay' define cada cuanto se reintenta un envio de replicacion que ha fallado; no es el intervalo de disparo ni el tiempo de expiracion del job.

question: A developer needs to define vanity URLs in the dispatcher configuration file. Under which property would this be defined?
correct: /vanity_urls
reason: Las vanity URLs se declaran en la farm del dispatcher bajo la propiedad /vanity_urls.

question: A developer needs to configure two style options (style-a and style-b) for a text component so authors can choose between different pre-defined styles for their content. What is the correct way to define the cq:editConfig node?
correct: Option A
reason: La definicion correcta usa las propiedades con prefijo cq: dentro de cq:editConfig/cq:style: cq:styleClasses con el array de clases (style-a, style-b) y cq:styleLabel con la etiqueta que ve el autor. Las variantes con cssClasses, cssStyles o cssLabel no existen.

question: A developer is tasked with designing a solution to accommodate multiple client projects within a single Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) instance, each requiring its own set of unique resources, code, and content. Given the need for true multi-tenancy, where each tenant operates independently with zero knowledge of other tenants and no shared code, content, or common authors, which approach should the developer recommend?
answers: Implement separate author and publish instances for each tenant, ensuring complete isolation of resources, code, and content, thereby achieving true multi-tenancy.
Encourage the use of component groups and allowedPaths properties to logically separate tenant- specific components and templates within the same AEM instance.

Utilize AEM's out-of-the-box multi-tenancy capabilities to segregate tenants within the same author and publish instances, relying on access control lists (ACLs) and content path organization to ensure separation.
correct: Implement separate author and publish instances for each tenant, ensuring complete isolation of resources, code, and content, thereby achieving true multi-tenancy.
reason: Multi-tenancy real, con aislamiento total de recursos, codigo y contenido y sin autores comunes, exige instancias de author y publish separadas por tenant. Los grupos de componentes, allowedPaths y las ACLs solo dan separacion logica dentro de la misma instancia.

question: While configuring SSO with SAML 2.0 compatible IDP on AEM, a developer notices an infinite loop between the IDP and AEM when trying to log in to AEM using SSO. Which dispatcher-specific configuration is required to prevent this scenario?
correct: Config File: filters.any Config: /0100 {/type "allow" /method "POST" /url "*/saml_login"}
reason: Hay que permitir explicitamente el POST a */saml_login en filters.any del dispatcher. Si el dispatcher bloquea ese POST, el navegador queda atrapado en un bucle infinito entre el IDP y AEM.

question: A customer has the requirement to use SAML authentication on AEM using their SAML 2.0 compatible IDP. Example: AEM: www.wknd.com/content/siteB/index.html IDP: https://www.idpB.com How should an AEM Developer configure their SAML Authentication Handler?
correct: com.adobe.granite.auth.saml.SamlAuthenticationHandler.path: /content/siteB com.adobe.granite.auth.saml.SamlAuthenticationHandler.idpUrl: https://www.idpB.com
reason: El SamlAuthenticationHandler se configura con 'path' (la ruta protegida, /content/siteB) e 'idpUrl' (la URL del proveedor de identidad). userIntermediatePath solo define donde se crean los usuarios sincronizados.

question: A client wants to ensure that only specific components are available to content authors when using an editable template in AEM. Additionally, they require that certain fields within a content fragment model adhere to strict validation rules for data integrity. Which two steps would the developer take to meet both requirements? (Choose two.)
answers: Use editable templates to directly configure field validation rules.
Configure field validation within the content fragment model.
Create and assign a new workflow to enforce component usage.
Enable dynamic templates for flexible content creation.
Define policies in the editable template to control allowed components.
correct: Configure field validation within the content fragment model.
Define policies in the editable template to control allowed components.
reason: Las politicas (policies) de la editable template controlan que componentes puede usar el autor, y las reglas de validacion de los campos se definen dentro del propio content fragment model.

question: A developer wants to deliver personalized content on a webpage. Which rule should be applied in the dispatcher configuration to ensure cache efficiency?
answers: Cache .html files but configure dispatcher to invalidate the cache when URL parameters (query strings) are present.
Enable caching for all POST requests to improve performance on forms and other dynamic interactions that modify content.
Block caching for all .html pages to ensure that every page load is served directly from the AEM publish instance.
correct: Cache .html files but configure dispatcher to invalidate the cache when URL parameters (query strings) are present.
reason: Para contenido personalizado se siguen cacheando los .html, pero se configura el dispatcher para invalidar/ignorar la cache cuando la peticion lleva parametros de query. Cachear POST o no cachear nada arruina el rendimiento.

question: A developer created an editable template named home-template in AEM application 'wknd'. What is the internal structure created for this template in the CRX repository?

Option A.alt: Estructura bajo /conf con home-template de tipo cq:Page.

Option B.alt: Estructura bajo /conf con home-template de tipo cq:Template.

Option C.alt: Estructura bajo /apps con home-template de tipo cq:Template.

Option D.alt: Estructura bajo /apps con home-template de tipo cq:Template (variante).

correct: Option B
reason: Las editable templates viven en /conf/<app>/settings/wcm/templates/<nombre>, donde wknd y settings son sling:Folder, wcm y templates son cq:Page y el nodo de la plantilla es de tipo cq:Template. Las variantes bajo /apps o con la plantilla como cq:Page son incorrectas.

question: Which action is typically performed by a replication agent in AEM?
answers: Transferring content and digital assets from the author instance to the publish instance.
Synchronizing user permissions between the author and publish instances.
Transferring Core components for use in AEM Sites.
correct: Transferring content and digital assets from the author instance to the publish instance.
reason: Un agente de replicacion transporta contenido y assets digitales desde la instancia de author a la de publish. Los permisos de usuario no se sincronizan por replicacion y los Core Components se despliegan como codigo.

question: A customer is required to fetch only "jcr:title" property for pages created using the homepage template. How would the developer write the query using Querybuilder API?

Option A.alt: Consulta con jcr:content/cq:template, p.hits=selective y p.properties=jcr:title.

Option B.alt: Consulta con jcr:title/cq:template, p.value=full y p.properties=cq:title.

correct: Option A
reason: Con la QueryBuilder API hay que filtrar por la propiedad jcr:content/cq:template y pedir unicamente la propiedad deseada con p.hits=selective y p.properties=jcr:title.

question: A developer is adding a reference script to a third-party analytics tool. The script needs to be editable since it is being modified on a schedule outside of the team's development cycle. How should the developer complete this task?
answers: Add a new component with the script in the HTL.
Add the script to the page policy on the template.
correct: Add a Generic Analytics Snippet.
reason: El Generic Analytics Snippet permite anadir y editar el script de analitica desde la interfaz de AEM, sin necesidad de un despliegue de codigo cada vez que el proveedor lo modifica.

question: The customer has a requirement to fetch images from a custom folder (folder1) which were modified on/after 1 January 2024. How would the Adobe Experience Manager Developer write the query to get the requested data?
answers: select [jcr:path] from [nt:base] where isdescendantnode('/content/dam/folder1') AND [jcr:content/cq:lastModified] >= CAST("2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z")
select [jcr:path] from [dam:Asset] where isdescendantnode('/content/dam/folder1') AND [jcr:content/cq:lastModified] >= CAST("2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z")
select [jcr:path] from [cq:image] where isdescendantnode('/content/dam/folder1') AND jcr:content.[cq:lastModified] >= CAST("2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z")
correct: select [jcr:path] from [dam:Asset] where isdescendantnode('/content/dam/folder1') AND [jcr:content/cq:lastModified] >= CAST("2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z")
reason: La consulta correcta usa el tipo [dam:Asset] bajo la carpeta del DAM y filtra por jcr:content/cq:lastModified con un CAST a fecha. [nt:base] recorreria nodos que no son assets y [cq:image] no es el tipo de los assets del DAM.

question: A developer is asked to create an Adobe Experience Manager servlet MyServlet that listens for HTTP requests capable of handling the GET method. The servlet must be registered using Declarative Services (OSGi) and be bound to a specific resource type /my/resourcetype allowing it to serve requests for a particular component. What is the correct way to register a servlet?
answers: @SlingServletResourceTypes(resourceTypes ="/my/resourcetype", methods = {"get"}) public class MyServlet extends SlingSafeMethodServlet { @Override protected void doGET(SlingHttpServletRequest request, SlingHttpServletResponse response) throws ServletException, IOException { // Handle get request } }

@SlingServletResourceTypes(resourceTypes="/my/resourcetype", methods = { "GET" }) public class MyServlet extends SlingAllMethodsServlet { @Override protected void doGet(SlingHttpServletRequest request, SlingHttpServletResponse response) throws ServletException, IOException { // Handle get request } }

@SlingServletResourceTypes(resourceTypes ="/my/resourcetype", methods = { "get" }) public class MyServlet extends SlingSafeMethodServlet { @Override protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) throws ServletException, IOException { // Handle get request } }
correct: @SlingServletResourceTypes(resourceTypes ="/my/resourcetype", methods = {"get"}) public class MyServlet extends SlingSafeMethodServlet { @Override protected void doGET(SlingHttpServletRequest request, SlingHttpServletResponse response) throws ServletException, IOException { // Handle get request } }
reason: El registro declarativo de un servlet por resource type se hace con @SlingServletResourceTypes y el metodo que hay que sobrescribir es doGet (con SlingHttpServletRequest/Response). OJO: la clave de este dump marca la opcion A, pero A escribe doGET (no sobrescribe nada) y usa SlingSafeMethodServlet; la unica opcion con la firma correcta es la B.

question: A developer is tasked with displaying the results from an external API call using Server Side Rendering in Adobe Experience Manager. Which actions would the developer take to complete this task?
answers: Create an OSGi Component foo with an HTTP Client. Create a Sling Model that references foo. Create an AEM Component flarp that displays the data from the Sling Model.

Create an OSGi Component foo with a service declaration of Servlet. Create a Sling Model that references foo. Create an AEM Component flarp that utilizes JavaScript Use API to display data from the Sling Model.
Create an AEM Component foo with an HTTP Client. Create a Sling Model that references foo. Create an OSGi Component flarp that displays the data from the Sling Model.
correct: Create an OSGi Component foo with an HTTP Client. Create a Sling Model that references foo. Create an AEM Component flarp that displays the data from the Sling Model.
reason: Para Server Side Rendering: un componente OSGi con el HTTP Client encapsula la llamada externa, un Sling Model lo referencia y el componente AEM pinta los datos desde el modelo. Las otras opciones invierten los roles entre componente OSGi y componente AEM.

question: A client has a requirement to get the location of stores based on the zip code authored in the component dialog. Location needs to be pulled from an external API using OSGi services. Which OSGi Service code snippet should be used to represent the requirement?
answers: @OSGIService(component = Service.class) public class ServiceImpl implements Service { @Override public List<String> getStoresByZipCode(String zipCode) { List<String> storeLocations = new ArrayList<>(); // Create an HTTP client try (CloseableHttpClient httpClient = HttpClients.createDefault()) { // Processing logic to get all the locations from external api } catch (IOException e) { } return storeLocations; } }

@Component(service = Service.class) public class ServiceImpl implements Service { @Override public List<String> getStoresByZipCode(String zipCode) { List<String> storeLocations = new ArrayList<>(); // Create an HTTP client try (CloseableHttpClient httpClient = HttpClients.createDefault()) { // Processing logic to get all the locations from external api } catch (IOException e) { } return storeLocations; } }

@Service(service = Component.class) public class ServiceImpl implements Service { @Override public List<String> getStoresByZipCode(String zipCode) { List<String> storeLocations = new ArrayList<>(); // Create an HTTP client try (CloseableHttpClient httpClient = HttpClients.createDefault()) { // Processing logic to get all the locations from external api } catch (IOException e) { } return storeLocations; } }
correct: @Component(service = Service.class) public class ServiceImpl implements Service { @Override public List<String> getStoresByZipCode(String zipCode) { List<String> storeLocations = new ArrayList<>(); // Create an HTTP client try (CloseableHttpClient httpClient = HttpClients.createDefault()) { // Processing logic to get all the locations from external api } catch (IOException e) { } return storeLocations; } }
reason: Un servicio OSGi se registra con @Component(service = Service.class) sobre la clase de implementacion, usando las anotaciones de Declarative Services. @OSGIService no existe y @Service(service = Component.class) invierte los roles.

question: A developer is writing a unit test for a service that depends on a query of nodes inside the JCR. What is the correct approach to unit testing the service?
answers: Use an @Mock annotation on the Query object with when and then methods.
Add the currentResource method call to include the nodes to be queried.
Use SlingContext with ResourceResolverType of JCR_OAK.
correct: Use an @Mock annotation on the Query object with when and then methods.
reason: Cuando el servicio depende de una Query del JCR se mockea el objeto Query con @Mock y se define su comportamiento con when(...).thenReturn(...), sin levantar un repositorio real.

question: A website hosted on AEM as a Cloud Service features site page content search as part of their user experience. The search internally uses JCR Queries for content search based on tags. The content has been indexed adequately. Which approach is recommended to make the index available across all the environments?
answers: Customize out-of-the-box index and deploy with Maven configurations and CI/CD Pipelines
Create Index Package from Package Manager and replicate over other environments
Create fully custom index and deploy with Maven configurations and CI/CD Pipelines
correct: Customize out-of-the-box index and deploy with Maven configurations and CI/CD Pipelines
reason: En AEM as a Cloud Service lo recomendado es personalizar el indice out-of-the-box (p. ej. damAssetLucene-8-custom-1) y desplegarlo como configuracion del proyecto Maven a traves del pipeline de CI/CD, de forma que llegue identico a todos los entornos. Replicar paquetes de indices no es una via soportada.

question: A developer needs to upgrade an existing custom component based on Core Components Version 1 (v1) to Core Components Version 2 (v2). How should the developer upgrade to this version?
answers: Modify the sling:resourceType property on the custom component to point to the V2 Component
The Custom Component will be automatically upgraded to the V2 Core Component on AEM Restart
Modify the sling:resourceSuperType property on the custom component to point to the V2 Component
correct: Modify the sling:resourceSuperType property on the custom component to point to the V2 Component
reason: Para subir un componente propio de Core Components v1 a v2 se apunta sling:resourceSuperType al componente v2; sling:resourceType identifica al propio componente y no se toca. La actualizacion nunca es automatica.

question: A developer is debugging an issue where a Sling Model is not properly adapting to the resource. Upon investigation, the developer notices the following Sling Model code: @Model(adaptables = Resource.class) public class MyCustomModel { } What is causing the issue?
answers: The adaptable type in the @Model annotation is incorrect.
The title field is not properly annotated with @Inject.
The resource path in the init() method is hard-coded and may not be adaptable.
The @PostConstruct method is not properly annotated.
correct: The resource path in the init() method is hard-coded and may not be adaptable.

images.alt: Codigo del Sling Model con la ruta hardcodeada en init().

reason: El Sling Model falla porque el init() tiene la ruta del recurso hardcodeada: el modelo deja de adaptarse correctamente en cuanto se usa sobre otro recurso. La ruta debe obtenerse del recurso adaptado, no escribirse a mano.

question: A developer is creating a dialog for a component, which has a checkbox field. After saving the component configuration, the developer noticed that the checkbox value is stored as a String type in JCR. What should be done to store the checkbox value as a Boolean type in JCR?
answers: Implement JCR Event Listener to change field type afterwards
Add TypeHint field to the dialog
correct: Add TypeHint field to the dialog
reason: Para que el valor de un checkbox se guarde como Boolean en el JCR hay que anadir al dialogo un campo oculto TypeHint (name='./propiedad@TypeHint', value='Boolean').

question: A university wants to roll out content updates to all the schools affiliated with it. The individual schools have configured their respective homepages with a space allocated to display updated university information. The rest of the homepage is dedicated to school-specific information. What is the recommended approach to roll out university updates on all the schools' homepages?
answers: Mark the "Partial" option on the roll out screen
Restore inheritance for certain components on the school homepage
Implement custom logic for page roll out action
correct: Mark the "Partial" option on the roll out screen
reason: Se marca la opcion 'Partial' en la pantalla de rollout para propagar solo los componentes heredados (el bloque de informacion de la universidad) sin pisar el contenido propio de cada escuela.

question: A developer is using the Oak query engine. Which query language is recommended?
correct: XPath
reason: XPath es el lenguaje de consulta recomendado por Adobe para el motor de consultas de Oak; es para el que el motor esta mas optimizado.

question: How would a developer create a new Adobe Experience Manager project version 2.0 for 6.5 using the Adobe Experience Manager Maven Archetype with package com.mysite?
answers: mvn -B org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-archetype-plugin:3.2.1:generate \ -D archetypeGroupld=com.mysite \ -D archetypeArtifactld=aem-project-archetype \ -D archetypeVersion=6.5 \ -D appTitle="My Site" \ -D appld="com.adobe.aem" \ -D version="latest" \ -D aemVersion="2.0"

mvn -B org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-archetype-plugin:3.2.1:generate \ -D archetypeGroupld=com.adobe.aem \ -D archetypeArtifactld=aem-project-archetype \ -D archetypeVersion=50 \ -D appTitle="My Site" \ -D appld="mysite" \ -D groupld="com.mysite" \ -D version="2.0" \ -D aemVersion="6.5"

mvn -B org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-archetype-plugin:3.2.1:generate \ -D archetypeGroupld=com.adobe.aem \ -D archetypeArtifactld=aem-project-archetype \ -D archetypeVersion=${jabebrrl_nmqjiwqo} \ -D appTitle="My Site" \ -D appld="siteld" \ -D groupld="com.mysite" \ -D version="2.0" \ -D aemVersion="latest"
correct: mvn -B org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-archetype-plugin:3.2.1:generate \ -D archetypeGroupld=com.adobe.aem \ -D archetypeArtifactld=aem-project-archetype \ -D archetypeVersion=50 \ -D appTitle="My Site" \ -D appld="mysite" \ -D groupld="com.mysite" \ -D version="2.0" \ -D aemVersion="6.5"
reason: El comando correcto usa archetypeGroupId=com.adobe.aem, archetypeArtifactId=aem-project-archetype, una version concreta del arquetipo, groupId=com.mysite, version=2.0 y aemVersion=6.5. Las otras opciones intercambian groupId con aemVersion o dejan la version del arquetipo sin resolver.

question: Which tool is commonly used to manage front-end dependencies and automate tasks like bundling, minification, and transpilation in an AEM project?
correct: Webpack
reason: Webpack es la herramienta que empaqueta, minifica y transpila el front-end dentro del modulo ui.frontend de un proyecto AEM.

question: An Adobe Experience Manager team is using an additional DEV environment in Adobe Experience Manager as a Cloud Service as their UAT env. An Adobe Experience Manager architect is asked to configure a dedicated url endpoint to be used as preview service for the same environment. Which configuration will accomplish this task?
correct: /apps/<Project Name>/osgiconfig/config.publish.uat/<Persistent Identity>.cfg.json in ui.config project
reason: El preview service se configura sobre el tier de publish y con el run mode del entorno: la configuracion OSGi va en el proyecto ui.config bajo /apps/<proyecto>/osgiconfig/config.publish.uat/<PID>.cfg.json.

question: A customer created a workflow launcher to trigger the "Custom Workflow" based on "Node Created" under the folder /var/classes but the workflow is not triggered. What is the reason the workflow is not triggered?
answers: "Workflow Process Legacy Mode" is disabled at the "Adobe Granite Workflow Configuration Service" OSGi configuration.
AEM does not allow new nodes to be created under /var/classes.
Changes under /var/classes do not trigger workflows.
correct: Changes under /var/classes do not trigger workflows.
reason: Los cambios bajo /var no disparan workflow launchers: esa rama esta excluida del procesamiento de launchers, por lo que el 'Custom Workflow' nunca se activa.

question: A developer needs to customize the handling of assets in a complex workflow model where different paths process assets based on their metadata and trigger specific external services. Which approach is a best practice for implementing this solution?
answers: Use out-of-the-box Adobe Experience Manager Workflow steps and configure them through the Workflow console to handle all metadata for asset processing, using conditions in the Workflow.
Write custom workflow process steps in Java to handle specific metadata conditions and integrate external services, using the Workflow API to manage dynamic branching logic.
Implement a content fragment model to pre-define asset metadata, using Workflows only for publishing the fragments after external service calls are completed.
correct: Write custom workflow process steps in Java to handle specific metadata conditions and integrate external services, using the Workflow API to manage dynamic branching logic.
reason: Para ramificacion dinamica segun metadatos y llamadas a servicios externos se escriben process steps propios en Java usando la Workflow API; los pasos out-of-the-box no cubren esa logica condicional.
